scope_warning: Only metadata-level definitions and operator semantics, NOT native compiled code, live HTTP execution or application performance benchmark.
query_template: select row_to_json(s) as raw, md5(row_to_json(s)::text) as raw_md5, n.nspname as namespace,a.amname as method,f.opfname as family,op.oprname as operator_name,op.oprleft::regtype::text as operator_left,op.oprright::regtype::text as operator_right,op.oprresult::regtype::text as result_type from pg_amop s join pg_opfamily f on f.oid=s.amopfamily join pg_namespace n on n.oid=f.opfnamespace join pg_am a on a.oid=f.opfmethod join pg_operator op on op.oid=s.amopopr order by n.nspname,a.amname,f.opfname,s.amopstrategy,s.amoplefttype,s.amoprighttype,s.oid
source_evidence: Read-only pg_amop raw entire records and joined pg_operator signature; raw_md5 calculated by PostgreSQL for every row; stable order with pagination.
methods: search means index searchable predicate; ordering means distance/ordered scan with sort operator family
